candidate.title: Banff quivers coincide with the source-or-sink-recursive mutation class B prime
candidate.author: Ervin, Tucker J.; Jackson, Blake
candidate.difficulty_reason: The proof constructs a mutation sequence avoiding a covering pair by separating an acyclic predecessor or successor subquiver, and proves that deletion and mutation commute for all required induced subquivers. This turns arbitrary covering-pair recursion into source-or-sink recursion uniformly, a nonroutine quiver-structure reduction; the direct containment corollary is not counted.
